column1: # SC-509c key set for cross-derivation comparison. COMPARE SETS, NOT COUNTS.
# The key is (case, consumer, session, agent_ref). Neither the agent ref nor
# the locus-without-session is unique: 64 (case, consumer, ref) triples name an
# agent appearing under MORE THAN ONE session in the same digest.
# evidence=state  : the entry's own agents[].state, a NORMATIVE self-declared
# evidence=alert  : a watchdog alert whose target names the owner and whose
#                   summary names the contribution, still current at capture.
# P222 = the ruled population. P128/P108/P88 are the earlier state-only
# sub-populations, retained so the prior comparison stays checkable.
# THIS FILE IS FROZEN, AND THAT IS A DECLARATION, NOT A DEFECT. It is a census of
# ONE table state, kept fixed so an independent derivation has a stable reference
# to compare against. It has no generator, which is why its divergence from the
# live table went unnoticed until it was measured; the relation below makes the
# The relation is HISTORICAL, so it can never go stale: this file's key set must
# EQUAL the SC-509c key set of that blob, forever. verify-obligations.py checks
# it (KEYSET-FROZEN) and reports the live delta against the current table, so
# drift stays visible without the file pretending to be current. The spelling is
# CUT-FROM, not SOURCE, deliberately: `^SOURCE:` is the registry-freshness
# grammar, which demands re-derivation whenever its source moves — the wrong
# relation for an artifact whose whole value is that it does NOT move.
# Measured drift at declaration (2026-08-24), AS SETS, because a count comparison
# reports the wrong thing in both directions here — 222 -> 228 reads as a net +6
#   +12  A3b c04/c05 ro+rw x 3 json consumers: fake:low and fake:high, carried by
#        `action=throttled` events whose summary does not begin "throttled for".
#    -6  A2 c01-filters ro+rw x 3 sessions on inter_needsattnstopped_json, whose
#        live scope is empty under SC-521b/SC-521c, so no session is a possible
#        descendant and no reason obligation is owed there.
